`solve_model` still takes snapshots from `n.snapshots`, rather than the stored model snapshots. Its new helper only flattens a MultiIndex when the model is flat; it does not otherwise restore the model’s representation. Thus, if the network’s snapshots are changed to a simple index after building a MultiIndex model, `extra_functionality` receives that simple index instead of the representation used to build the model.
